hooks.prompt:
A git command just ran in this portfolio repository. Its tool call and output, as JSON: $ARGUMENTS

If the command created no commit (git commit --dry-run, nothing to commit, an amend that only rewords, or git commit only as text in a string), answer ok true and stop.
Otherwise read .claude/agents/test-writer.md and follow it exactly, with the files of the last commit (no file is named to you, so files under .claude/ are skipped).

Answer ok true when nothing had to be written. When you wrote tests, answer ok false with its report as reason.
